shortDescription: Cranbrook, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - September 23, 2026) - DLP Resources Inc. TSXV:DLP (OTCQB: DLPRF) (FSE: J8C) ("DLP" or the "Company") announces that it intends to extend the term of an aggregate of 6,486,706 common share purchase warrants (the "Warrants") issued as part of the Company…

children: ") announces that it intends to extend the term of an aggregate of 6,486,706 common share purchase warrants (the "
") issued as part of the Company's private placement that closed on January 31, 2025. The Warrants are exercisable at a price of $0.40 and currently expire on January 31, 2027.
Subject to the approval of the TSX Venture Exchange (the "
"), the term of the Warrants will be extended to January 31, 2028. All other terms of the Warrants will remain the same.

DLP Resources Inc. is a mineral exploration company operating in Peru and Southeastern British Columbia exploring for Base Metals and Cobalt. DLP is listed on the TSX-V, trading symbol DLP and on the OTCQB, trading symbol DLPRF. Please refer to our web site
